author: mara
story: A private notebook for field technicians, kept in a private internal collection with no connectors and no model. Jonas keeps a note of his own; Tomas keeps two notes from Austrian and Czech visits and then searches his own notes for the contactor job he did.

input.note: RCD trips after rain, ordered a type B module.
Replaced the contactor on connector 2, three test sessions fine.
Display froze, reboot cleared it. Firmware is current.
